* If his game text is canceled, the text cannot be used to take him into hand when about to be lost.
* If he is hit during battle and then excluded from the battle (e.g. by [[Clash Of Sabers]]) he is inactive and so cannot use his text to be taken into hand. He is immediately lost due to being hit while outside of a battle.
* A Light Side Force icon could be added to the same location as [[Palpatine, Emperor Returned]] (e.g. due to [[Presence Of The Force]]). This does not violate Palpatine's text or cause him to be removed from table.

|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 (version 4 of 4, in date order). It is the current text.
* '''Original''' ([[Palpatine, Emperor Returned]], 18 March 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (18 March 2021). Players Committee card image, 18 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-palpatineemperorreturned-20210318.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/palpatineemperorreturned.png Holotable commit c241f88 “vset14”], no mark). Text: “Never deploys or moves (even if carried) to a location with a [Light Side] icon. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Once per game, if about to be lost, may take him into hand. Immune to attrition.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Palpatine, Emperor Returned (Errata)]], 31 May 2022): Players Committee card image, 31 May 2022: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-palpatineemperorreturned-20220531.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/13a5f3a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/palpatineemperorreturned.png Holotable commit 13a5f3a “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs”], no mark). Text: “Never deploys or moves (even if carried) to a location with a [Light Side] icon. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Once per game, if about to be lost, may take him into hand. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details and the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” (was “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd”); the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Palpatine, Emperor Returned (Errata 2)]], 11 December 2022): Players Committee card image, 11 December 2022: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-palpatineemperorreturned-20221211.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e9980f9/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/palpatineemperorreturned.png Holotable commit e9980f9 “Set 20 Errata, 2020 AIs, and a few fixes”], mark “E1”). Text: “Never deploys or moves (even if carried) except to an [Episode VII] location without a [Light Side] icon. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Once per game, if about to be lost, may take him into hand. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' “to a location with a [Light Side] icon” became “except to an [Episode VII] location without a [Light Side] icon”; the card prints the errata mark “E1”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
* '''PC-E3''' (this page, 12 December 2025): Players Committee card image, 12 December 2025: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-palpatineemperorreturned.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ffcb1fc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/palpatineemperorreturned.png Holotable commit ffcb1fc “First Order Icon”], mark “E1”). Text: “Never deploys or moves (even if carried) except to an [Episode VII] location without a [Light Side] icon. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Once per game, if about to be lost, may take him into hand. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' the icon in the top-left corner was redrawn (“First Order Icon”); nothing else changed. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 3 by release order (PC-E3); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
